class Receive {
  async complete(pending: { id: string; marks: string[] }): Promise<void> {
    const outcome = { kind: "bad" as string };
    const restored = { proofs: null as string[] | null, answered: true };
    if (restored.proofs) return;
    const state = "unspent";
    if (outcome.kind === "bad" && state === "unspent") {
      await (await this.useStore()).abort(pending.id);
      throw new Error("bad_solution");
    }
    if (outcome.kind === "unknown" && restored.answered && state === "spent") {
      await (await this.useStore()).lose({ id: pending.id, marks: pending.marks });
      throw new Error("store_unavailable");
    }
    throw new Error("store_unavailable");
  }
  async useStore(): Promise<{ abort(id: string): Promise<void>; lose(row: unknown): Promise<void> }> {
    return { async abort() {}, async lose() {} };
  }
}
